english.title: Procure instrument / thing to cause miscarriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully procured an instrument or other thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..), knowing that the same was intended to be unlawfully used or employed with intent to procure the miscarriage of a woman, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawfully procured instrument/thing
knew it was intended
for unlawful use/employment
with intent to procure miscarriage of woman

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A woman having an abortion does not commit an offence when acting in relation to her own pregnancy, see section 241 of the Crime and Policing Act 2026.
(ii) The woman in this case does not have to be with child (pregnant).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
